title: Motion Camera
description: This Mod interpolates your Third-Person Camera Movements to make them appear smooth.
body:
**Motion Camera** is a client side Fabric mod that smooths the third person camera for a more cinematic experience.

# 📦Features

 - Smooth camera tracking
 - Per-axis interpolation control
 - Custom commands

## ✨Smooth Camera Tracking

Third person camera movement is interpolated using exponential moving average, creating a natural lag that follows the player rather than snapping instantly.

![Showcase](https://r2.fakecrime.bio/uploads/a6d32ed9-d779-4841-a35c-914d39c6a9e0.gif)

## 🕹️Per-Axis Control

Each axis (X, Y, Z) has it's own tracking speed slider, allowing you to customize smoothing behavior however you like.

## ⚙️Configuration

All settings are available through Mod Menu:
- Toggle the mod
- Adjust tracking speed per axis
- Enable first person smoothing

## ⌨️Commands

- /motioncamera toggle - toggle the mod
- /motioncamera factor <value> - sets all axes to the same percentage
- /motioncamera factor <x> <y> <z> - sets each axis

If you find any issues/incompatibilities with the mod, you can send them to me on discord @.lol11
